tone.summary: A layered signal chain starting with compression for smooth dynamics, followed by a Chorus effect to enhance the clean arpeggios. The core tone uses the UK 50/UK Vintage 4x12 combination for a warm, mid-focused crunch, finished with subtle delay and room reverb.
